lcc_original: 因此人纔離開父親和母親，同他的妻子膠結，二人就成爲一體了。
notes: UNV 父/母 (abbreviated) → LCC 父親/母親 (full form with 親); semantic alignment is unambiguous
Hebrew direct object marker {<WAH0853>} kept implicit before both 父親 and 母親 — LCC renders no explicit particle for את
UNV 與 → LCC 同 (both = 'with/together'); prefix tag <WAH09002> assigned to 同 since it corresponds to the Hebrew prepositional prefix on wife
LCC adds 他的 (his) before 妻子 — no Hebrew SN equivalent; left unannotated
LCC 纔 (adverb 'then/just') before 離開 — no separate Hebrew equivalent; 離開 carries <WH05800><WTH8799>
LCC 就 before 成爲 is a Chinese connective with no Hebrew equivalent; 成爲 carries <WAH01961><WTH8804>
LCC sentence-final 了 (aspect particle) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
二人 has no SN tag in UNV either (implied in Hebrew); correctly left unannotated in LCC
